preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid is between 1 and 20, inclusive.
The number of columns in the grid is between 1 and 20, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string must not exceed 10^4 characters.
The output string must only contain the characters 'L', 'R', 'U', and 'D'.

postconditions.expression: exists(obstacle_position | all(final_position != obstacle_position for obstacle_position in ((x, y) for x in range(1, R+1) for y in range(1, C+1))))
postconditions.description: There must exist a sequence of instructions such that the final position of the robot is different from the position of the obstacle for all possible positions of the obstacle.
